Much turning and twisting in scrotum.

Loose, deep cough, without expectoration and without

Loose cough at night.
I I Much hawking causing a short cough.

mation of eyes and pain in ears.

■ Catarrh: with much phlegm and rheumatic pains ; with

Constantly obliged to expectorate.

When speaking, is obliged to spit out a frothy saliva.

Hawking; mucus yellowish and somewhat bloody.

Constant hawking, something is always loosening, but still

^^ Neck and Back. Fain deep in r. side of neck near oesoph-
agus, a fine, sticking, cramplike, constant pain.

Pain in nape of neck which hinders turning.

Sticking pain in back as if something was sticking in
spine, < by bending back.

Forgetting all his business he crept into a corner and said

Sound sleep undisturbed by any difficulties.

Stupid midday sleep with confused dream.
^'^ Time. Morning: seminal discharge; no erections.

Evening: dizzy and nauseated ; headache lasts into night;

Cold water: does not > burning in eyes; much thirst for.

Perspiration and thirst after unsatisfactory coition.

Perspiration when walking.

Objective, Ulcers in the nose and mouth,". — [60.] Catarrh
and heat of the head, at noon,'. — Sudden attack of coryza, with sneezing,
running from the nose, frequent copious discharge of mucus, which very

intervals, however, frequent easy hawking of large lumps of mucus, to-
gether with transient headache at times here and there (after triturating),'.
— Sneezing,'. — Sneezing, catarrh, and discharge from the nose,". — Sub-
jective. Constant sensitive feeling in the nose, always on drawing in the
air, which seems cold, athough it is warm,*. — Increased itching in thejiose
while eating,'.
